copy.headline: State Theatre to host free Texas vs. Texas A&M rivalry watch party
copy.caption: The State Theatre in Austin is set to host a free Texas vs. Texas A&M rivalry watch party on Black Friday. Doors will open at 5:30 p.m. ahead of the 6:30 p.m. kickoff, according to event organizers.
